data.name: Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!!
data.detailed_description:
With its own unique battle system and a wide selection of characteristic angels, the girls are appearing on Steam for the first time in [Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!!]!!

Discover new meta gameplan as you play!


From the basic battle mechanics such as performing "Arcana Combo" with the pressing of the correct buttons in sequence, "Homing Action" and "Arcana Burst", to the more advanced and spectacular "Extend Force", "Arcana Eclipse" and "Arcana Blaze", dozens of ways to decimate your opponent! Find out more about the mechanics in the game!

23 playable Angels with 23 free selectable Arcanas!


Equip the unique characters with an Arcana of your choice, and explore the boundless amount of strategies that can be derived!

Plentiful story!


Every character has their own "Main Story", as well as a special "After Story in the Hotspring", all fully voiced! (in Japanese).
In addition, all characters have extra "Short Stories" (non-voiced), giving you the chance to understand your character more than ever!
Dive into the world of Arcana Heart!

More than just simply fighting!


In short, there is "Story Mode", "After-Story Mode", "Survival Score Attack Mode", "Trial Mode", "Time Attack Mode", "Versus Mode", "Training Mode", "Replay Theatre Mode" etc. etc. and many more!
Also, in the "Gallery Mode", you can unlock Event CG illustrations and Link-Animations, and view the Angels' short stories!

Online Network capable!


Players who are up to the task can test their prowess online, via the "Rank Match" or "Player Match" mode.
Players can save their battle results and scores online, and compare their scores with other players in the Leaderboard too!
Show the world that your Angel is the #1 wa-, *ahem*, Angel in the world!

Special Purchase Bonus!


Discover more about each Angel's charming points with the 144-page filled "Link Anime Drafts Collection" that comes with each purchase!
When you're feeling exhausted after a heaty battle, open up the Collections and be refreshed!
*They will be placed in your Steam folder:
...\Steam\SteamApps\common\Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX\Digital Extras\

reviews.review:
Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!! is an energetic and surprisingly sophisticated 2D fighting game that combines colorful anime aesthetics with an intricate combat system built around speed, creativity, and strategic customization. Developed by EXAMU Inc. and published by Arc System Works, it distinguishes itself from traditional fighting games through its unconventional movement mechanics and supernatural combat abilities. Beneath its charming character designs lies a demanding competitive experience that rewards technical mastery and experimentation. While its presentation may not appeal to everyone, the impressive mechanical depth makes it a compelling choice for enthusiasts seeking something different from conventional fighting games.

The combat system is undoubtedly its greatest achievement, offering an exciting mixture of aerial movement, elaborate combinations, and tactical resource management. The Homing Action mechanic allows fighters to pursue opponents through the air, transforming ordinary encounters into fast-moving battles where positioning and reaction speed are essential. Arcana Combos provide opportunities to execute extended attack sequences, while defensive techniques such as Arcana Burst help players escape dangerous situations. Advanced mechanics including Extend Force, Arcana Eclipse, and Arcana Blaze introduce additional strategic possibilities, allowing experienced players to develop increasingly sophisticated offensive approaches. These interconnected systems create exhilarating battles, although understanding their full potential requires considerable dedication.

One of the game's most distinctive features is its extensive customization system, featuring 23 playable characters and 23 selectable Arcanas. Each character possesses unique attacks, movement characteristics, and combat strengths, while Arcanas provide additional supernatural abilities that influence individual fighting styles. With 529 possible character and Arcana combinations, players have tremendous freedom to experiment with different strategies. Some combinations encourage aggressive pressure, while others emphasize defensive techniques or specialized abilities. This flexibility significantly enhances replayability and encourages players to explore unconventional approaches. However, the sheer number of possibilities can initially overwhelm newcomers unfamiliar with advanced fighting game mechanics.

Beyond its competitive foundation, the game provides a surprisingly generous selection of single-player content. Every playable character features an individual Main Story accompanied by a humorous After-Story centered around hot spring scenarios. These narratives include Japanese voice acting, giving the cast additional personality and helping establish their relationships. Supplementary short stories expand character backgrounds further, although these sequences lack voice performances. The storytelling generally prioritizes entertaining interactions and lighthearted anime humor over dramatic complexity, making it enjoyable for players interested in character-driven experiences without demanding extensive narrative investment.

The available gameplay modes provide additional reasons to continue playing beyond the main story. Survival Score Attack challenges endurance against successive opponents, while Time Attack encourages efficient victories. Trial Mode offers structured opportunities to improve execution, and Training Mode provides an essential environment for practicing combinations and experimenting with different Arcanas. Versus Mode supports direct competition, while Replay Theatre allows players to revisit recorded encounters and evaluate their performance. Gallery Mode adds collectible illustrations, character animations, and supplementary stories. The included 144-page Link Anime Drafts Collection further enhances the package with extensive artwork that enthusiasts of the game's visual identity can appreciate.

Visually, Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!! embraces a vibrant anime-inspired presentation filled with expressive character designs, colorful backgrounds, and dramatic special attacks. Its character animations communicate personality effectively, while supernatural abilities produce spectacular visual effects during combat. The energetic soundtrack complements the action, and Japanese voice performances strengthen the individuality of the fighters. However, certain graphical elements reveal the limitations of its older visual foundations, particularly when compared with more technically advanced fighting games. Additionally, the abundance of effects can occasionally make intense encounters difficult to follow, especially when multiple supernatural abilities appear simultaneously.

Online multiplayer introduces Ranked Matches and Player Matches, allowing players to challenge opponents beyond local competition. Leaderboards provide additional motivation to improve personal performance and compare accomplishments. Unfortunately, online play represents one of the game's weaker areas. Its networking can struggle with latency, making precise inputs and defensive reactions less dependable during unstable connections. Finding suitable opponents may also prove challenging because of the game's relatively specialized audience. Fortunately, local multiplayer and Steam Remote Play Together offer alternatives for players who prefer competing with friends.

Steam Deck compatibility is officially classified as Unsupported. Although the game includes full controller support and relatively modest hardware requirements, Valve does not certify this version as compatible with Steam Deck. Players may encounter technical limitations or require additional troubleshooting when attempting to run it through Proton. Consequently, purchasing it specifically for handheld play carries some uncertainty. Those prioritizing portable compatibility should be aware that the separate Arcana Heart 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! XTEND edition has a Verified Steam Deck classification.

Despite its impressive strengths, the game presents several accessibility challenges. Its demanding mechanics can discourage beginners, particularly those expecting straightforward button combinations and immediately understandable combat systems. The anime presentation and character-focused humor may also feel overly specialized for certain audiences. Furthermore, inconsistent online accessibility and the availability of an expanded edition reduce the appeal of purchasing this particular version at full price. Nevertheless, its extensive customization, responsive combat mechanics, and substantial single-player content provide meaningful entertainment for players willing to invest time in mastering its systems.

Ultimately, Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!! remains an inventive and mechanically rewarding fighting game whose greatest strength lies in its extraordinary combat flexibility. Its combination of aerial mobility, supernatural customization, distinctive characters, and extensive gameplay modes creates an experience that becomes increasingly satisfying as players develop their skills. Although its steep learning curve, aging presentation, and online limitations prevent it from achieving universal appeal, the underlying fighting mechanics remain remarkably engaging. For dedicated anime fighting game enthusiasts, it offers substantial depth, personality, and long-term replayability.

A technically ambitious and entertaining fighting game with exceptional customization and rewarding combat, held back by accessibility challenges, online limitations, and officially Unsupported Steam Deck compatibility.

Rating: 8/10
